blocks.title: Factory pattern
blocks.text: Factory design pattern ek khaas workshop jaisa hai jo mukhtalif products banana janta hai: aap ko fikr nahi karni ke woh kaise bante hain; aap bas factory ko batate hain ke kya chahiye aur woh aap ko tayyar product de deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Factory pattern bayan kijiye aur bataiye ke yeh seedhe objects banane se kaise mukhtalif hai, misal ke saath (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Seedhe banane mein object chahne wale code ko theek class ka naam lena aur use banane ka tareeqa jaanna parta hai; factory ke saath code bas factory se maangta hai aur factory tay karti hai ke kaunsi class aur kaise banani hai. Maslan drawing app shape factory ko 'circle' ya 'square' keh kar theek shakal le sakti hai; nayi shakal jorne se sirf factory badalti hai, shakal istemal karne wali har jagah nahi.

items: Factory: factory se product maangein; object banane ka tareeqa woh sambhalti hai, workshop ki tarah.
